messages:
Maya (People Ops): FYI need comp exception + relocation stipend approval for candidate CAND-902. Manager asking to place in IC4 band and provide one-time relocation stipend of $7,500. Candidate wants 2026-07-15 start and will be remote-to-office after 6 months.

Maya (People Ops): Key offer numbers below:
```
role: Fullstack Engineer
manager: Carlos
requested_base: $165,000
requested_relocation: $7,500 (one-time)
current_band(IC3): $125k - $150k
requested_band(IC4): $150k - $170k
requested_start: 2026-07-15 (remote start)
note: relocation is flexible payment (lump or reimbursement)
```

Carlos (Hiring Manager): Candidate moved cross-country last month, high-impact frontend infra work, led migration to React+TS across 2 teams. Asking IC4 because they have lead experience and will mentor juniors. I can cover base in hiring budget.

Nina (Recruiter): Candidate verbally said they'd accept if relocation covered and ability to work remote for first 6 months. They prefer lump-sum.

Sam (Comp): Two asks: 1) provisional band elevation needs calibration write-up, 2) relocation stipend policy check. Policy allows up to $8k for exceptional cases but needs Finance signoff if >$5k.

Maya (People Ops): Tagging finance: @Sam can you ping Finance and confirm whether $7.5k requires extra approvals? Also we need to document the provisional elevation with 6-month review.

Sam (Comp): Finance confirmation: flagged — anything above $5k requires one-time finance approval. I'll add to comp packet and request finance OK. Also please include proposed 6-month evaluation criteria.

Carlos (Hiring Manager): For eval criteria: delivery of migration milestone A, mentoring two new hires, maintain <=3% page-regression errors. I'll draft a short measurable list and attach.

Nina (Recruiter): Candidate asked about benefits effective date with remote start and later office move. Does benefits start on payroll date or first of month? Also asks if relocation is taxable.

Maya (People Ops): Benefits: standard SRP — benefits effective date depends on payroll rules; usually first of month after start or 30 days depending on sign-up. Relocation taxable: yes, typically taxable income unless reimbursed with receipts. We'll confirm exact payroll tax treatment.

payroll-bot: Payroll note: if pay date is within same month, benefits may start first of next month. Relocation reimbursements processed on expense run and subject to tax withholding.

Sam (Comp): I'll route to comp-committee AND finance for $7.5k. Need manager doc + candidate acceptance window. What is candidate's deadline for response?

Nina (Recruiter): Candidate expects an answer within 4 business days. Holding off on sending formal offer until approvals done.

Maya (People Ops): Plan: 1) Sam adds to comp-committee on Thurs 9am 2) Sam to request finance approval for relocation 3) People Ops to prepare provisional offer language (remote start, relocation lump-sum, 6-month review). Target to finalize by Thu EOD.

Carlos (Hiring Manager): I'll upload the calibration doc and scorecards to hiring drive. Link: https://company.share/hiring/CAND-902-records.pdf

Nina (Recruiter): Noted. I'll draft candidate-friendly wording about taxable relocation and benefits timing so candidate isn't surprised.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all. If comp & finance sign off we'll send offer with start 2026-07-15 and relocation paid as lump-sum on first payroll after start. Will update thread once approvals in. :sparkles:
